name: Living Lake Spawn
body:
LIVING LAKE SPAWN
CR 9

XP 6,400
N Huge ooze
Init +4; Senses blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 8, flat-footed 20 (+12 natural, –2 size)
hp 162 (12d8+96 plus 12)
Fort +14, Ref +4, Will +11
Immune gaze attacks, visual effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, polymorph, stunning

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 4 slams +16 (2d6+9)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks constrict (2d6+9), engulf (2d6+9 bludgeoning, AC 16, 10 hp)
Spells Prepared (CL 8th):

5th—insect plague
4th—blight (DC 19), flame strike (DC 19), summon nature’s ally IV
3rd—call lightning (DC 18), dominate animal (DC 18), poison (DC 18), sleet storm
2nd—animal trance (DC 17), flaming sphere (DC 17), heat metal (DC 17), hold animal (DC 17)
1st—calm animals (DC 16), charm animal (DC 16), cure light wounds, obscuring mist, produce flame, summon nature’s ally I
0 (at will)—detect magic, flare (DC 15), purify food and drink, virtue

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 10, Con 27, Int 15, Wis 20, Cha 15
Base Atk +9; CMB +17 (+21 grappling); CMD 27 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Cleave, Combat Casting, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Knowledge (local) +14, Knowledge (local) +14, Perception +17, Survival +19; Racial Modifiers +2 Survival
SQ Aquan, Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Engulf (Ex)

A living lake that has grabbed an opponent can try to engulf the creature in its body. This ability functions as swallow whole, except for the following changes. An engulfed creature is trapped in the living lake’s body, where the ooze inflicts automatic slam damage each round. In addition, an engulfed foe has no air to breathe and must hold its breath or risk drowning (see the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game, Chapter 13, Environment, for rules on drowning). A living lake can engulf 1 Large, 2 Medium, 4 Small, 8 Tiny, 16 Diminutive, or 32 Fine creatures. If an engulfed creature cuts its way free, living lake simply flows together again and can still use its engulf attack.
